notes.title: MUZY - 1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
MUZY has been updated to the version 1.0.2 (not to be confused to the patch 1.0.3 from the old demo)

What's new:

 Fixed a bug where the cage bars could open up
 Fixed a bug where Alpha Muzy could grab and carry a player through a wall
 Fixed a rare bug where a room with corridors and an elevator on the 1st floor would not spawn
 Fixed a bug where you could open the door at the top in the end game
 Fixed a bug with no collider on the ceiling in the server room
 Fixed a bug where the green access card could not be lifted from some places on the floor

notes.title: MUZY Demo Update - Enhanced Maze, Improved Gameplay, and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
We're excited to bring you the latest update for MUZY Demo, packed with improvements to make your demo experience even more engaging and enjoyable. Our team has been hard at work refining levels, addressing bugs, and enhancing gameplay. Here's a glimpse of the key changes in this update:

Patch Highlights:

Maze Marvels:
Updated Level with Maze: Get ready for a new challenge! We've introduced a maze to one of the levels, adding an exciting twist to your demo experience. Navigate through the maze and conquer this thrilling addition.

Player-Friendly Adjustments:
Easier Maze: We've heard your feedback! The maze has been adjusted to provide a more user-friendly experience, ensuring a balance between challenge and enjoyment.
Better Hints: Enjoy improved hints throughout the game, providing clearer guidance to enhance your understanding of the challenges you face.

Bug Squashing:
Fixed Rare Snake Level Freeze: Bid farewell to a rare bug! We've addressed an issue where the snake level could freeze, ensuring a smoother and uninterrupted gaming experience.

Entrance Enhancements:
Improved Targets at Game Area Entrance: Your journey begins with precision! Targets at the entrance to the game area have been enhanced, accompanied by helpful hints to assist you in hitting the mark.

Visual Improvements:
Improved Camera Interpolation: Notice the difference! The game now boasts improved camera interpolation, providing a smoother and more visually appealing experience.

Snake Game Refinement:
Shorter and Clearer Snake Game: Dive into an improved snake game! We've shortened the gameplay, especially on easy mode, making it more accessible and clear for players of all skill levels.

We value your feedback! Join the MUZY Demo community discussions to share your thoughts, strategies, and experiences with fellow players.
Thank you for being a part of the MUZY Demo experience. We hope you enjoy the enhanced maze, improved gameplay, and bug fixes in this update. Have a fantastic time exploring the updated demo!

notes.title: MUZY DEMO UPDATE - NEW SNAKE CHARACTER AND MORE
notes.notes:
Exciting news! We're thrilled to present the latest update for MUZY Demo, featuring a range of additions and improvements that promise to elevate your gaming experience. Here's a rundown of the key changes in this update:

Patch Highlights:

Dynamic Threats:

 Flying Copter Self-Destruct: The stakes are higher! The flying copter can now self-destruct if not taken down in time. Keep your wits about you and make every shot count to avoid explosive consequences!


Guidance on Your Journey:

 Abundance of New Hints: Your path is illuminated with wisdom! Discover an array of new hints strategically placed to guide you through challenges and levels. These hints are your allies, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience.


Snake Game Overhaul:

 Revamped Snake Model: Prepare for a visually enhanced snake game! We've completely overhauled the snake model, introducing a fresh look that adds a new level of excitement to your gameplay.


Hint Board Addition: 

 Navigate the snake game with finesse! A brand new hint board has been integrated, offering valuable tips and strategies to maximize your performance in the revamped snake experience.

notes.title: MUZY Update - Refined Gameplay, Enhanced Levels, and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
We're excited to bring you the latest update for MUZY, introducing a variety of changes to improve your gaming experience. Our team has been hard at work, addressing feedback, refining levels, and squashing bugs to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable adventure. Here's a summary of the key changes in this update:

Patch Highlights:

Level Design Refinements:

 Moved the Kids Gun in the First Room: We've adjusted the placement of the Kids Gun to enhance the flow of the initial gameplay.
 Moved Blue Key in the Game Room: Expect a strategic twist as we've relocated the Blue Key within the game room.


Gameplay Simplifications:

 Simplified Game with Tiles: We've introduced a tile-based system to simplify the gaming experience, making it more intuitive and engaging.
 Simplified Parkour Level in Easy Mode: Enjoy a smoother parkour experience in easy mode, ensuring a more accessible and enjoyable journey.


Clues and Enhancements:

 Added Sound and Light Clue Above the Scoreboard: Navigate the parkour level with ease, thanks to a new sound and light clue strategically placed above the scoreboard.


Labyrinth Level Modifications:

 Labyrinth Level Easier to Understand: We've made adjustments to the labyrinth level to provide a clearer and more intuitive experience for players.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed Several Bugs: Our team has diligently addressed and resolved various bugs, ensuring a more stable and seamless gaming experience.

notes.title: MUZY Update - Enhancements, Bug Fixes, and More!
notes.notes:
Patch Highlights:

Enhancements Across the Board:


 We've implemented various enhancements to elevate your overall gaming experience. From visual improvements to performance optimizations, you can expect a smoother and more polished adventure in the world of MUZY.


Bug Fixes for a Seamless Gameplay:


 Our team has diligently squashed pesky bugs that may have affected your enjoyment. Say goodbye to any disruptions, and get ready for a more seamless and immersive gaming session.


New Content Incoming:

 Brace yourselves for fresh content! Discover new challenges, quests, and rewards as we introduce exciting additions to the MUZY universe. Stay tuned for more details within the game.


Community-Requested Features:

 We've listened to your feedback and implemented features requested by the community. Your input is invaluable, and we're committed to continuously improving MUZY based on your suggestions.


How to Update:

 To access the latest features and improvements, simply launch MUZY on your preferred gaming platform. The update will be automatically downloaded, ensuring you're ready to embark on a new and enhanced adventure.


Connect with Us:

 Join the MUZY community on social media and share your experiences. We love hearing from our players and welcome your thoughts on the latest update.
 Thank you for being a part of the MUZY community. We hope you enjoy the latest features, fixes, and additions that make your journey in MUZY even more captivating.


Happy gaming!
